SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-01-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAR-01-2023 BY VISITING JUDGE RONALD E. QUIDACHAY. PLAINTIFF RHODA RONQUILLO IS PRESENT AND ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED TAGALOG INTERPRETER CAROLINE CARRERA. DEFENDANT EVELYN BROOKS IS PRESENT AND ASSISTED BY MS LUCAS (DAUGHTER).
